text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
DIVINAAAAA!!!!!
GRACIAS!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... El...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El-chan... Whew~...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen" is decided!
No one can catch up! Nobody can reach them!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa takes a brilliant victory on mighty wings!
Behold, the world's immortal phoenix—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was truly the moment—when a world-class talent
became reality.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno...! Bue... no...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Waaahhhhhhh...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El... did it, desu...
Now I'm not all talk, I'm the world's stronk...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhhhhh!
Waaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly rushed over to her side to soothe her.
Having poured everything into the race, she seemed unable to hold back her emotions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the award ceremony.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Duel and battle, concluded right here!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And claiming victory in the final major race of the year is... El Condor Pasaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And El is not crying!
Even if it looks that way,
I was definitely not crying, see!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That was just some dust in my mask! Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: R-i-g-h-t!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She felt overwhelmed by the pressure... She seems a bit self-conscious about breaking into tears before the huge crowd.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now then! Since I won, just as promised, El will be taking on the world from here!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To unleash this power
that I forged together with Grass and Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Howevvver, strength is not the only thing
we must deliver to the world.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Did everyone have fun today, YES!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Did that fire you up!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! This kind of passion and excitement
can't be built on strength alone!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Having friends to compete with, walking through the same era together,
honing each other, clashing fiercely, with everyone eager
to witness the unfolding drama—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And that is how this Arima Kinen was born, yes!
This blazing hot, fierce battle...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to take this heat
to the world stage!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I won't let you see a boring race—not for a single lap, not for a single second!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We Umamusume run
in order to bring joy to everyone, YESSS!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A certain wrestler once said:
"Might does not make right. Right makes might."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Then allow me to say this!
The world's strongest is not the world's greatest..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "The world's highest rating proves you're the world's strongest!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Grass. Thank you,
Spe-chan. Thank you, all my fans!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Next, Trainer and I will take the world by storm
and make El-El cheers echo across the globe!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan, El-chan is incredible,
El-chan is...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass-chan, is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's nothing. Just...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm lonely.
That's all it is..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ailes! Ailes! Ailes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The never-ending chants echoed across Nakayama in the twilight."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Alongside her victory, El Condor Pasa put on the ultimate race for her fans.
